_comment: Machine-readable record of the manifest version and date at which each clinical safety document was last formally reviewed and signed off by the Clinical Safety Officer (CSO). Update this file — not check-doc-versions.js — whenever a CSO review is completed. The check script reads these entries to compute 'minor releases behind' and escalate accordingly.

incremental_reviews.scope: Clinical-matching changes only (single ACB scorer, STOPP NSAID/aspirin term parity, completeness + contract-test CI).

Limitations 43-46 (Triage North Star wave 1) reviewed and confirmed; limitation 43 amended per H-045 review condition (strip silent when Request Monitor disabled). Recorded via Dave's session instruction delegating completion to his digital twin.

docs.notes: CSN v3.10. FULL CSO clinical-hazard re-baseline completed at 3.115.0 (Dr Dave Triska, 2026-06-17, signed off by merge): the 3.64->3.113 backlog was closed — §2 intended-purpose updated for the Record tab, Practice Report/Condor, CQC Inspection Readiness, result-rule expansions and chrome/attestation additions; known-limitations 36 (Record snapshot/gap-markers), 37 (CQC supporting-evidence-not-proof) and 38 (Select-all) added; the v3.91.2 attribute-injection-XSS remediation and PDF.js 4.x upgrade are covered via HAZARD-LOG. Prior baseline was 3.64.0 (2026-06-13).

incremental_reviews.scope: Added H-031 (cross-surface clinical-score divergence, closed by the single ACB scorer); updated H-016/H-006 controls.
Audit-remediation sync v3.13 countersigned; H-043 (inline-widget wrong-patient write) and H-044 (vaccine false-GIVEN) added and accepted (ALARP).

H-045-H-048 (Triage North Star wave 1) added and accepted: H-045/H-046 Accepted (ALARP), H-047/H-048 Accepted at residual 2; controls verified against code and pinning tests. Recorded via Dave's session instruction delegating completion to his digital twin.

docs.notes: Hazard Log v3.16. CSO sign-off 2026-07-22 (Dr Dave Triska, via digital twin per session delegation) of the v3.15 Triage North Star wave 1 sync; H-045-H-048 added and accepted, no residual risk above 3. Prior full re-baseline remains 3.115.0 (2026-06-17).

SOUP v1.10. Reissued at 3.175.0 on 2026-07-18 (CSO Dr Dave Triska, recorded via PR #216): no SOUP changes since 3.115.0 — PDF.js 4.2.67 (+ worker), Chart.js 4.4.1 and D3.js 7.8.5 all re-verified byte-identical via scripts/verify-vendor.js; the v3.175.0 Patient Alerts module adds no third-party code. Prior reissue was v1.9 at 3.115.0 (2026-06-17).

Feature list v3.178.0 reviewed by CSO (Dr Dave Triska) on 2026-07-25 as part of the v3.178.0 Keeper clinical-rule change proposal (PR #221), which he reviewed and approved for merge. Scope of this review is the rule-set currency changes and the corresponding feature-list count/summary refresh (starter alerts 32 -> 35; new reception red flags; DEM004 correction) — it is not a full re-baseline of the whole document. Ledger continuity note: the doc was bumped 3.126.0 -> 3.177.0 in commit 8455ab1 (safety-doc sync) without a matching ledger update, so this entry also reconciles that gap; the intervening weekly feature-list refreshes were content syncs, not CSO reviews. Prior recorded review was 3.126.0 on 2026-06-21.
